# `.github/`

- [`dependabot.yml`](dependabot.yml) — weekly grouped updates for
  `github-actions` and `uv`, both rooted at `/`.
- [`workflows/`](workflows/README.md) — the CI workflow.

Repository-wide policy is in [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md); the workflow list
and gates are in [`workflows/README.md`](workflows/README.md).
